beats.say: Austria has no coast, yet in seventeen seventy-eight it reached islands now in India.
The Nicobar Islands, in the Bay of Bengal.
Denmark claimed them first, in seventeen fifty-six.
Its settlements failed; its company left in seventeen seventy-three.
Then trader William Bolts won Empress Maria Theresa's backing.
beats.cap: William Bolts, backed by Empress Maria Theresa

beats.say: His plan: Indian and Chinese goods straight to Austria, no middlemen.
beats.cap: India & China → Austrian ports, no middlemen

beats.say: He funded a trading post and fort there, with boats to Madras and Burma.
It failed after three years; his company went broke in seventeen eighty-five.
So landlocked Austria once had a foothold in India's islands.
